paragraphs.text: Map is an artifact type and predefined token introduced in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan .

Map tokens have “ , , Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores . Activate only as a sorcery. (Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it’s a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.) ".

Assessing Map tokens as a resource is as difficult as assessing creatures that explore, in that the output is somewhat random. Whereas entering-explorers can be partially baked into the creature's stats with a vanilla test , there are far fewer map creators whose rate requires measuring the same way. As such, it shares with treasure the quality of being expendable artifacts in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan to Craft or sacrifice, and also enables descend to a minor extent.

Maps, amongst the predefined tokens, are the first to require a creature and also the first to be limited to activation as a sorcery. The former, leading to diminishing returns, is something that occurs more in Constructed than in Limited , in that using Get Lost alongside board wipes can lead to an opponent unable to properly utilize a pile of Maps, as the card advantage is all lands and can't recoup the tempo lost after a wipe.
Several older artifacts were flavored as Maps, but don't have the Map type.
